localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description: Parking for RV's is limited depending on the size of the unit. 10 small units (tent trailer size) or 6 large RV's (30ft) and parking for 10 additional medium/small vehicles. The group area includes gravel camping pads, a large play field and a picnic shelter. The amphitheater, playground, and the first parking lot are all public spaces adjacent to the group site. Campground rules apply to group. Please go to http://www.env.gov.bc.ca/bcparks/explore/campingEthics.html for further details on campground regulations. Please see http://www.env.gov.bc.ca/bcparks/explore/parkpgs/mt_robson/ under Reservations for more details and conditions of group site rental. Contact the Park Operator directly for use of amphitheater stage (for example - Weddings) or if you have any questions concerning the group site.
